name: Pedro Lucas Bahiense
bio: Computer Science student at the University of São Paulo and President of RAIA.

name: Gabriel Campanelli Iamato
bio: Currently pursuing a degree in Data Science at the University of São Paulo (USP) – São Carlos, continuing studies in Machine Learning, with PIBIC scientific research focused on the comparative analysis of bike-sharing systems. He is part of the RAIA software development team, with a focus on AI and Computer Vision, and previously joined the sales and Data Science consulting team at ICMC Jr., both nonprofit initiatives.

name: Caio Petroncini
bio: Computer Science student at the University of São Paulo and Projects Director of RAIA.

name: Lucas de Souza Brandão
bio: Computer Science student at the University of São Paulo. Undergraduate-level researcher focusing on Data Science.

name: Gabriel Fagundes
bio: Software Engineer & Data Scientist combining academic expertise in AI and data science with professional experience in software engineering, delivering efficient, maintainable, and data-driven solutions. Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and software design, focusing on building reliable and scalable applications.

name: Luysa de Souza Gonçalves
bio: Computer Science student at the University of São Paulo and Partnerships Director of RAIA.

name: Bruna Pereira da Mata
bio: Software Engineer, almost graduated from USP, with a focus on Backend Development. I have two years of professional experience, in which I contributed to impact projects within the company, among them developing systems that reduced by 80% the number of activations, and restructuring flow that integrated more than 2 thousand daily data (~50%) that before were not considered.

name: Samuel Rubens Souza Oliveira
bio: Professional with experience in software development, infrastructure automation, and distributed systems. Specialist in microservices architecture, Kubernetes, and DevOps, with expertise in Go, TypeScript, Terraform, and cloud platforms.

name: Beatriz Fugi
bio: Undergraduate student in Marketing Technology at Fundação Getulio Vargas, with a Bachelor's degree in Nutrition from the Universidade de São Paulo and a specialization in Nutrition, Metabolism, and Exercise Physiology from FMRP-USP. Currently, I am part of the Marketing Board at the Artificial Intelligence Advancement Network (RAIA), where I produce content for social media.

name: Pedro Augusto Ribeiro Gomes
bio: Founder and former President of RAIA, studying Computer Science at ICMC - USP São Carlos.

name: Pedro Kenzo Muramatsu
bio: Former Co-President, current Advisor of RAIA. Distributed Computing Engineer at CERN and incoming Backend SWE II at QuintoAndar. BsC Computer Science @ ICMC USP, full-ride research exchange @ Kyushu University
education: University of São Paulo (USP), Kyushu University

name: Luísa Shimabucoro
bio: Founder and former Projects Director of RAIA. Interested in ML areas, with emphasis on NLP and Vision. Computer Science student at USP, having worked at the University of Edinburgh and Cohere For AI as a researcher.

name: Pedro Augusto Monteiro Delgado
bio: Former President of RAIA during the 2025 term. Computer Science undergraduate at ICMC-USP, in an exchange program with the University of Bern, Switzerland. Interested in exploring the application of artificial intelligence tools in areas of public interest, such as health and education.
